body:
## Changelog
* 95b7f3e777a4c685599b6b75cfcfc0d8cbbd9fd9 Clarify Machine config flags (#5274)
* a798342bf74203554628cc83db5eecf12de4bae4 Fix duplicate digests in Machine image references (#5273)
* ecf52f670bdb6966e4cbcd82513095c0abd06d29 Honor --yes when a deploy would detach a volume (#5268)
* 2890baa0ef31ece0848127bcb3fbff2fa68043d6 Return from fly logs --no-tail when the buffer is empty (#5254)
* bbc8e3834e77a42c03c627b2b83da98b28aed7b0 Name --region when fly mpg create cannot ask for one (#5270)
* a30b798e75860ed98dd7136cf5432697153254a2 Let --plan select the Performance plan (#5269)
* 4d178896feabf26fc4089644c199fededee98272 Say so when a first deploy allocates no IP addresses (#5256)
* 6e7f3fff4dfd031028906b47d22ccb0bc8fa039f Make the overwrite prompt respect non-interactive runs (#5257)
* 1e452a0f9df97b790a8539e69c1c3881ffbe1968 Keep metrics failures out of headless output (#5255)
* 7d3970b5dad2a1b3c9e5e2b83a2a56ba354b7eb0 Show ProdPack in `fly redis list` output (#5264)
